cause.en: A billing condition blocks the request: prepaid credits at zero, an organization or workspace monthly spending limit reached, included usage used up without pay-as-you-go, or a failed invoice payment.
cause.id: Kondisi tagihan memblokir request: kredit prabayar nol, batas belanja bulanan organisasi atau workspace tercapai, kuota bawaan habis tanpa pay-as-you-go, atau pembayaran tagihan gagal.

user_fix.en: Follow the link in the error message to add credits, update the payment method, or change the spending limit.
user_fix.id: Ikuti tautan di pesan error untuk menambah kredit, memperbarui metode pembayaran, atau mengubah batas belanja.

operator_fix.en: Fix billing in the admin panel, then resume traffic. Do not retry automatically.
operator_fix.id: Perbaiki tagihan di panel admin, lalu jalankan lagi trafik. Jangan retry otomatis.

cause.en: The account cannot access the resource: the model is not on your subscription tier, you tried to delete a base model, or workspace permissions block it.
cause.id: Akun tidak bisa mengakses resource: model tidak termasuk tier langgananmu, kamu mencoba menghapus model dasar, atau izin workspace memblokirnya.

user_fix.en: Check your subscription tier and model access, or ask the workspace admin.
user_fix.id: Cek tier langganan dan akses model, atau tanyakan ke admin workspace.

operator_fix.en: Grant the workspace access to the model or upgrade the tier.
operator_fix.id: Beri workspace akses ke model atau naikkan tier.

cause.en: The resource does not exist: an invalid model ID or endpoint path, a deleted file, job or conversation, or a typo in the URL.
cause.id: Resource tidak ada: ID model atau path endpoint salah, file, job, atau percakapan sudah dihapus, atau salah ketik di URL.

user_fix.en: Check the model ID and endpoint path; use the list endpoints to confirm the resource exists.
user_fix.id: Cek ID model dan path endpoint; pakai endpoint list untuk memastikan resource ada.

operator_fix.en: Keep model IDs in configuration and update them when models are retired.
operator_fix.id: Simpan ID model di konfigurasi dan perbarui saat model dipensiunkan.

cause.en: The JSON is well formed but a value is invalid: wrong data type, an enum value outside the allowed set, or an array that is too long.
cause.id: JSON-nya benar tapi ada nilai yang tidak valid: tipe data salah, nilai enum di luar pilihan, atau array terlalu panjang.

user_fix.en: Read the field-level details in the response body and compare with the API schema.
user_fix.id: Baca detail per field di body respons dan bandingkan dengan skema API.

operator_fix.en: Validate request bodies against the schema before sending.
operator_fix.id: Validasi body request terhadap skema sebelum mengirim.
